title: Location postpositions with a singular genitive
summary: Use a singular genitive before a location postposition: pöydän alla (“under the table”).
targetSkills: Location postpositions with a singular genitive
objectives: Use a singular genitive before a location postposition: pöydän alla (“under the table”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A postposition comes after its complement. Here the complement is genitive: the order is noun in genitive + postposition.
These sentences describe a stationary location. The postposition stays the same while the noun identifies one object or several, as requested.
Noun models: pöytä → pöydän, tuoli → tuolin, auto → auton, sänky → sängyn. Kissa on gives the complete subject-and-verb frame.
keyPoints: Place alla or vieressä after the genitive.
